Monica,

Thanks for taking this. Short version: HorizonMed needs a production-ready dedicated inference pool colocated in the Ireland region (eu-west-1) to support a clinical notes summarization feature we're launching Q1. Our procurement timeline is tight — we need commercial terms and an initial PO by the first week of January to hit our dates.

High-level requirements:
- Expected steady-state: ~800k tokens/day across mixed gpt-style generation and embeddings.
- Concurrency: typical concurrency 80–150 concurrent active sessions; peak bursts to ~300 for short windows.
- Model variants: one large generation model (approx comparable to 13B dense) and an embedding model used for rerank/semantic search.
- Preferred hardware: A100 / H100 tier equivalence (we can consider lower-cost A10g if you recommend).
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II, dedicated logs retention 12 months, VPC peering.

I've attached our RFP and traffic spreadsheet (HorizonMed_RFP_Dec2026.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to a dedicated pool in eu-west-1 with the above profile and provide a sizing + cost + lead time recommendation? Also include any minimum committed capacity and recommended burst strategy.

Appreciate a brief call this week if possible — Alejandro

Monica / team — quick sizing notes based on Alejandro's spreadsheet and our latency assumptions: attached is a short calc (capacity_calc_sheet.csv) and a one-page recommendation (sizing_proposal_v1.pdf). TL;DR:

Recommendation (first-pass):
- Pool config: 10x A100-80GB nodes dedicated (single-tenant), configured into two availability sub-pools for redundancy.
- Autoscale buffer: target steady-state sized for p50 traffic; reserve +20% headroom to handle normal variance; configure burst path to allow up to 18 nodes during high traffic windows (we can gate bursts by cost banding & token thresholds).
- Model split: put generation model on A100s with 16GB KV cache per node; embed index/embedding ops can share quantized replicas on A10g nodes if customer prioritizes cost — suggested hybrid: 10xA100 + 6xA10g for embedding-heavy workloads.
- Expected throughput: with this mix, p95 latency target for generation ~600–800ms (depends on prompt sizes); embeddings throughput will be high with quantized A10g.
- Estimated incremental monthly cost (infra only, rough): EUR 78k–110k (depends on A100 vs H100 pricing and sustained discounts).
- Lead time: If GCP can confirm capacity, we can stand up the pool in 2–3 weeks; VPC peering + SOC2 evidence collection may add 1–2 weeks.

Assumptions: 70/30 generation/embedding split, median prompt+response tokens 120, 95th 600. If HorizonMed's med/95 numbers are higher we'll need to scale nodes.

Next steps: finalise token distribution from customer, confirm GCP availability, prepare proposal PDF and SOW.

-Neha
